  Keep the title in Conventional Commit form, e.g. "feat(scrollbar): add autoHide".

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do, and why? Link any related issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] ✨ `feat` — new feature
- [ ] 🐛 `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] 📝 `docs` — docs / Storybook only
- [ ] ♻️ `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] ⚡ `perf` — performance
- [ ] ✅ `test` — tests only
- [ ] 🔧 `chore` / `ci` — tooling / pipeline

## Changeset

- [ ] I ran `pnpm changeset` and committed the file (**required** for any
      user-facing change — it drives the version bump + CHANGELOG), **or**
- [ ] This change is internal-only and needs no release.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes (zero warnings)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (added/updated tests where relevant)
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md`) and/or a Storybook story added
- [ ] Accessible, SSR-safe, and dependency-free where possible
